value.name: informs supervisor of care plan
value.description: Asha tells the supervisor that a large order and medication reconciliation were started today, that the family chose Bridgepoint, and that she will wait for confirmation there.
evidence: that a medication reconciliation started today, that the family had chosen Bridgepoint, and that she would wait there for confirmation rather than have it routed through the social worker who had been mentioning the state bed.

value.name: supervisor agrees to page doctor
value.description: The supervisor reacts to Bridgepoint and says she will page the doctor.
evidence: The supervisor's mouth tightened at Bridgepoint and softened again at today, and she said she would page the doctor.

value.name: asha thanks supervisor without warmth
value.description: Asha thanks the supervisor without smiling and keeps holding her father's hand as the supervisor leaves the room.
evidence: Asha thanked her without smiling and did not let go of her father's hand while the woman stepped back into the corridor.

value.name: asha sends draft to marcus
value.description: From the bed-tray laptop, Asha sends Marcus a short draft message asking who is listed as their father's healthcare proxy.
evidence: Asha sent the draft to Marcus from the bed-tray laptop, kept the message short, and added one line at the bottom asking him to tell her which of them was actually listed as their father's healthcare proxy, because Bridgepoint would need that name on the packet by tomorrow.

value.name: waits for read receipt
value.description: Asha watches the message send and leaves the laptop open while waiting for a response.
evidence: She watched the send icon resolve and then set the laptop aside without closing it
Before the read receipt came up

value.name: receives defensive message from marcus
value.description: Asha sees that Daniel is calling Marcus on another line and Marcus replies defensively that Daniel is already pressuring him.
evidence: her own phone buzzed: Daniel, calling Marcus on a separate line, she could tell from the way her brother's reply pinged in a moment later, fragmented and defensive—Daniel's already on me, give me a sec.

value.name: asha ignores marcus reply
value.description: Asha chooses not to answer Marcus because doing so would reopen the family argument and make him go quiet again.
evidence: Asha read it twice and did not answer, because answering would mean explaining to Marcus that Daniel had no standing here and risking Marcus hearing only the old shape of the argument and going quiet again.

value.name: holds father's hand and waits
value.description: Asha presses harder into her father's hand and waits with the portal still open and the proxy field empty.
evidence: She pressed her thumb a little harder into her father's hand and waited, the cursor in the portal still blinking where the proxy field was empty
